description: This file contains helper functions used for testing and scripting git interactive rebase operations, including setting fake editors, checking rebase states, and automating rebase command sequences.

methods.name: set_fake_editor
methods.description: Sets up a fake editor script to simulate user editing behavior during rebase.

methods.name: set_cat_todo_editor
methods.description: Sets a fake editor to output the rebase todo list to stdout.

methods.name: test_linear_range
methods.description: Verifies that the revisions form a linear range with expected subjects.

methods.name: reset_rebase
methods.description: Aborts ongoing rebase and resets repository to a clean state.

methods.name: cherry_pick
methods.description: Automates cherry-picking and tagging a commit.

methods.name: revert
methods.description: Reverts a commit and tags it.

methods.name: make_empty
methods.description: Creates an empty commit and tags it.

methods.name: test_editor_unchanged
methods.description: Checks that environment variables related to editor configurations are unchanged.

methods.name: set_reword_editor
methods.description: Sets up environment and scripts for testing commit rewording during rebase.

methods.name: check_reworded_commits
methods.description: Verifies that reworded commits match expected commits.

methods.name: set_replace_editor
methods.description: Prepares a custom sequence editor for replacing the rebase todo list from a file.
